reviewer_profile: Systems-and-methods reviewer focused on routing logic, state definitions, robustness, and reproducibility risk
summary: PATD proposes fixed-topology decentralized delegation via terminal-consensus competence calibration. Document is unusually detailed in state/packet/routing definitions but suffers from hand-tuned scoring constants, hard-coded gates that contradict emergent-specialization claims, and a credit assignment gap for intermediate forwarders.
